name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted Whisper speech recognition REST API on CPU with transcription, translation, language detection and subtitle output, plus a Swagger UI to try it.

alerts.message: The API has no authentication: anyone who knows the URL can submit audio and use your server's CPU. Keep the domain private or put access control in front of it.
Transcription runs on the CPU. The model set in ASR_MODEL is downloaded on first start, so the service takes a while to come up, and larger models need several GB of RAM.
